title: Nonclosedness of an ordinary Sobolev restriction of a magnetic Airy operator
scope: For every fixed real c the explicitly ordinary H1_0 restriction is nonclosed. Its spectrum is C under the declared bounded-inverse convention. This does not resolve the all-parameter spectral problem for the distinct natural closed magnetic Dirichlet realization.
